_about: A model of one Dataflow Gen2 query, its project's regional settings and its data destination. Each column in Changed column type has a type, whether it may be empty (nullable), and a locale. A locale of null means the project's regional settings. Edit what the needs call for, and keep the steps in this order.
needs: The Shipments query reads every file in the bronze folder carriers/northwind_uk on each refresh and replaces silver_shipments with the result. Reports read silver_shipments, so its column types stay as they are.
Northwind UK writes dates as day/month/year, like 22/10/2026. Weights use a dot for decimals, like 12.5.
The other queries in this dataflow read files from US carriers. The project's regional settings stay English (United States).
A shipment that is still on its way has no delivered_on date yet. Those rows load with delivered_on empty. Every shipment reaches silver_shipments, so don't drop rows and don't make up dates.
